name: EPIC Suisse AG
summary: EPIC Suisse AG is a real estate firm operating within Switzerland. The company's activities are structured across two main divisions: existing investment properties and those under development or construction. Its core business involves both the acquisition and management of diverse real estate assets. These holdings include office buildings, logistics and industrial sites, and shopping centers. Founded in 2004, EPIC Suisse AG maintains its headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland.
